episodes.name: episode 1
episodes.material: final two figures of answer in falling sequence; middle voice rising scale-steps then CS figure higher
episodes.sequence: falling sequence (displaced sequence of falling thirds)

episodes.name: episode 3
episodes.material: rising steps of bar 12 into rising/falling theme imitated a fourth higher; bass combines C2 pattern with rising steps

episodes.name: episode 4
episodes.material: codetta figure direct and inverted; theme of ep.3; C2 figure; rising semitones in bass

episodes.name: episode 5

episodes.name: episode 6
episodes.material: codetta figure imitated by all three voices

episodes.name: episode 7
episodes.material: bass repeats end of previous entry; soprano develops end of C2
